newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Exito in $222 mln expansion.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Exito in $222 mln expansion.

text.p: Colombian supermarket chain Almacenes Exito will issue more stocks and bonds to help finance a $222 million expansion and modernization program, company president Gonzalo Restrepo said Friday.

Restrepo confirmed, in an inteview with Caracol radio, published reports that Exito was planning to float bonds on the local market worth up to $50 million, while increasing the number of its shares in circulation by about 40 percent.
About 11.7 million new shares will be offered exclusively to current stockholders, while an additional 35 million shares will be opened up to investors on local and foreign markets.
